title: Arkret Realm Snapshot
description: Closed signed inline Snapshot with signed purpose and complete same-cut coverage. full_recovery includes all caller-disclosable rows/heads/floors and retains the 8 MiB admission capacity. stream_history contains all disclosable target-stream rows plus exactly the required parent MemberState and Circle/Sidecar selector rows, and heads/floors only for their source streams. Its signed history_basis binds full Account identity (including Station), exact target, anchor and accepted cross-stream dependency refs. It is a new original with its own content ID, issued before the window ref, never a clipped signed original. Current disclosure rechecks every included component; unrelated scopes absent from this object do not invalidate it. Narrow objects never replace current/bootstrap/handoff or imply omitted state is absent. Existing signer-tenure, retention/redaction, cursor lifetime and atomic Account-frame checks remain mandatory.

governance_generation.description: Station tenure this snapshot is bound to. Current /head MUST equal the fresh current authority generation. Exact historical by-ref MUST equal its requested basis generation and may precede current authority after a valid handoff; the consuming Account Station or independent auditor resolves that tenure and its exact signing-time service key from the fresh genesis-to-current chain. Unknown/future tenure, wrong signer, old tenure presented as current head, or rollback of saved current/checkpoints MUST be refused. Ordinary clients apply the bound own-Station consumption contract rather than independently resolving governance history.

purpose.description: Signed installation purpose. Only full_recovery can replace a Realm current baseline. stream_history is bound to one Account historical window and MUST NOT clear omitted selectors or advance current checkpoints.

visible_stream_heads.description: Exactly the covered source streams at the signed cut. full_recovery covers every disclosed stream; stream_history covers its target plus only sources of necessary selector dependencies. No hidden directory.

current_state_entries.description: Complete disclosable selector set within the signed coverage, read at the same cut as covered heads and floors. Omitted selectors outside stream_history coverage do not mean empty or deleted.

retention_and_history_floor.description: Caller-authorized per-stream history floors and Realm history policy at the same durable cut as visible_stream_heads and current_state_entries; no floor for a hidden stream may be disclosed.
